title: there is there are
summary: **There is / There are** — «есть, имеется, находится»: так мы сообщаем, что что-то существует или где-то находится.
ru:
## Зачем нужен there is / there are
Чтобы сказать, что где-то **есть** какой-то предмет или человек, английский использует **there is / there are**. По-русски мы часто начинаем с места: «В комнате стоит стол». В английском сначала **There is**.
> There is a table in the room. — В комнате есть стол.
> There are two windows in the kitchen. — В кухне два окна.

## Единственное и множественное число
- **there is** (**there's**) — один предмет или неисчисляемое: *a book, some water*
- **there are** — несколько: *two books, some chairs*
> There's a cat on the sofa. — На диване кошка.
> There's some milk in the fridge. — В холодильнике есть молоко.
> There are three bags on the floor. — На полу три сумки.

## Отрицание
- **there isn't** (there is not) / **there aren't** (there are not)
- с множественным и неисчисляемым чаще **any**
> There isn't a bank near here. — Рядом нет банка.
> There aren't any shops on this street. — На этой улице нет магазинов.
> There isn't any sugar. — Сахара нет.

## Вопросы
Порядок слов меняется: **Is there ...? / Are there ...?**
> Is there a park near your house? — Рядом с твоим домом есть парк?
> Are there any eggs? — Яйца есть?
Краткие ответы: **Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. / Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.**
> How many students are there in your class? — Сколько студентов в вашем классе?

## There is и It is
**There is** говорит, что что-то существует. **It is** описывает уже известный предмет.
> There's a book on the table. **It's** a very good book. — На столе книга. Это очень хорошая книга.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~There is two chairs.~~ → There **are** two chairs.
- ~~Is a bank near here?~~ → **Is there** a bank near here?
- ~~It has a park in my city.~~ → **There is** a park in my city.
- ~~There are not any milk.~~ → There **isn't any** milk.
en:
## What are there is / there are for?
We use **there is / there are** to say that something exists or where it is.
> There is a table in the room.
> There are two windows in the kitchen.

## Singular and plural
- **there is** (**there's**) — one thing or an uncountable noun: *a book, some water*
- **there are** — more than one: *two books, some chairs*
> There's a cat on the sofa.
> There's some milk in the fridge.
> There are three bags on the floor.

## Negative
- **there isn't** / **there aren't**
- with plural and uncountable nouns we often use **any**
> There isn't a bank near here.
> There aren't any shops on this street.
> There isn't any sugar.

## Questions
> Is there a park near your house?
> Are there any eggs?
Short answers: **Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. / Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.**
> How many students are there in your class?

## There is and It is
> There's a book on the table. **It's** a very good book.

## Common mistakes
- ~~There is two chairs.~~ → There **are** two chairs.
- ~~Is a bank near here?~~ → **Is there** a bank near here?
- ~~It has a park in my city.~~ → **There is** a park in my city.
structure:
## Утверждение
| Число | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| единственное | there is / there's | There's a bus stop. |
| неисчисляемое | there is / there's | There's some cheese. |
| множественное | there are | There are six desks. |

## Отрицание
| Число | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| единственное | there isn't | There isn't a lift. |
| неисчисляемое | there isn't any | There isn't any water. |
| множественное | there aren't any | There aren't any chairs. |

## Вопросы и краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Краткие ответы |
|---|---|
| Is there a shop near here? | Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. |
| Is there any milk? | Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. |
| Are there any shops? | Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. |
| How many rooms are there? | There are four. |

## Формулы
> **There is / There are** + предмет + место
> **Is / Are there** + предмет + место?

## Запомните
- **there's** = there is, но ~~there're~~ не пишем;
- **a / an** — с исчисляемым в единственном числе, **some / any** — с множественным и неисчисляемым.

items.text: There {{is}} a park near my house.
There {{are}} five people in my family.
There {{is}} some tea in the pot.
There {{are}} a lot of cars on the road.
There {{is}} a good restaurant on this street.
How many days {{are}} there in a week?

exercises.instruction: Вставьте **there is / there are / there isn't / there aren't** (используйте краткие формы, где можно).

items.text: I can't see any buses. {{There aren't|There are not}} any buses.
{{There's|There is}} a lamp on my desk, but there isn't a computer.
The fridge is empty. {{There isn't|There is not|There's not}} any food in it.
My town is small. {{There aren't|There are not}} any big shops.
Look! {{There's|There is}} a rainbow in the sky.
The room is empty. {{There aren't|There are not}} any chairs.
